It is not clearly disqualifying on the visible text, so it stays eligible, but the trade-economics focus sits outside the core interest zones and the fit is weak.

The paper fit is slightly stretched by the advocacy-campaign focus (a partial gap versus the candidate's research/writing strengths), holding this in the "good realistic application" band rather than higher.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (AD.03.2)
